newsitem.title: USA: Kirlin says to take Q3 charge $0.25/shr.
newsitem.headline: Kirlin says to take Q3 charge $0.25/shr.

text.p: Kirlin Holding Corp said on Tuesday that it would record a third-quarter, pre-tax charge of about $675,000, or roughy $0.25 per share, as a result of a recently completed exchange offering.
The company said the offering allowed optionholders to surrender their options for cash and/or stock, reducing the number of options outstanding and diluting its earnings.
At the expiration of the offer, 448,488 options were surrendered in exchange for $537,298 and 19,802 shares of common stock, the company said in a statement.
In connection with the offering, Kirlin added, three of its executive officers exercised options to purchase 38,000 of common stock.
The exchange offer and exercise of options will reduce fully diluted shares by about 23 percent, the company said.
Kirlin Holding Corp is a holding company engaged in securities brokerage, securities trading, and investment and merchant banking activities.
